events.title: Notifications To Be Implemented
events.description: Omniscient has announced that he intends to implement notifcations properly onto the site. Giving credit to this thread for realizing the change needed to happen, Omniscient has already laying out a plan to see this much wanted feature into fruition.

events.title: From Zero to Hero
events.description: The gates of the marketplace have finally been opened to newly opened accounts after Omniscient reduced the required reputation to post from one to zero.

events.title: A New Smile For Your Profile
events.description: The following profile rules have been removed: 1) No religious, nationality, or political expression in your profile 2) No image rotation or scripts images (ip grabber) for your avatar or signature 3) No advertising of NFA (Non-Free Account) threads, sales, or services in your profile

events.title: Post to PM Allowed Now
events.description: Omniscient has removed the rule dissallowing users to require a post before the item or service was sent via private message

events.title: New Meme Forum Added
events.description: A new section has been added, Meme Shit Meme, or the MSM section with the sole purpose of meme-ing. The section requires all threads to be meme oriented with anything else being closed or junked. low-quality posting (LQP) rules do not apply in this section.
